title: Amazonian ayahuasca as a technology for building relationships with beings

tellings.quote: the Amazonians who developed Iawaska for example, you know, this is a true pharmacological technology.

plain: The peoples of the Amazon who developed ayahuasca, a plant brew drunk for its visions, created what amounts to a true drug-based technology, one for building relationships with the beings met in that state. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore says this on Michels's show, speaking in general terms without a named source. If he is right, the brew is less a ritual than a tool for deliberately making contact.
